blocks.text: Rome, Italy—Pope Leo XIV is out of bed, walking and eating following an operation to remove a cancerous tumor from his lung, and has undergone post-surgery tests which show his progress is “normal”, his doctors said Wednesday. Part of the pope’s right lung was removed in Tuesday’s operation at Rome’s Gemelli hospital and the leader of the world’s 1.4 billion Catholics is now awaiting the results of a biopsy to determine if the cancer has spread. Blood tests and a chest X-ray meanwhile “confirm a normal post-operative course”, doctors Luigi Carbone and Stefano Margaritora said in a statement released Wednesday by the […]...
